verdict.rationale: AgentMail is email infrastructure for agents, so in-product AI insights from inbox data is a fair question for this kind of SaaS product. However, the evidence shows no built-in feature that generates insights or suggestions from the user's data. The closest items do not qualify: the docs 'blueprint' generator works from a description of what you are building, not from your data; LangChain RAG/vector-store indexing is a developer building block in an external framework; and full-text search is keyword retrieval, not AI-generated insight.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
